scope: Narrow read-only tool status and bounded version probes over the canonical desktop harness catalog. This rework does not replace harness_catalog or change launch, restore, resume or update semantics.
changes: Added ToolStatus with exactly one row per harness_catalog entry, catalog-owned identity and launch metadata, bounded concurrent probes, timeout/failure/missing/present/unknown states, five-minute freshness and per-tool rerun.
Added a guarded Tools QML pane with live, failed, timeout, missing, unprobed and stale presentation plus all-check and per-row controls.
Exposed the status object through the desktop and isolated UI preview without adding a parallel registry, configuration section or tools.d surface.
Preserved Workspace, KeyMap, harness_catalog, saved-agent restoration, resume arguments and updater behavior unchanged.
Added focused process fixtures, production-QML coverage, architecture ownership/contract and status qualification rows.
